panel.summary: Formula guard misses spill-ghost and pivot cells: toggleCheckboxAt still reports `true` while setData silently no-ops
panel.evidence: The new guard at sheet.ts:3842 only bails on `cell?.f`. Two other cells are equally formula/definition-driven and are silently rejected downstream: (a) a spill ghost cell (`existing?.spillAnchor`) — `setData` returns at sheet.ts:1004 before writing; (b) any cell on a pivot sheet — `setData` returns at sheet.ts:995. In both cases `toggleCheckboxAt` runs `await this.setData(ref, next)` and then `return true`, so callers (view/spreadsheet.ts:366 re-renders, worksheet.ts:4853 re-renders) are told a toggle happened when nothing changed. The same read-only rationale the guard cites ("the formula drives the state") applies to a spill ghost, whose value comes from the anchor formula.
